tagline: Top rated Professional Liability attorney in Lone Tree, Colorado

about: Kari Hershey is an attorney providing legal services covering Professional Liability: Defense, Administrative Law, Appellate and Health Care.

Kari Hershey, who practices law in Lone Tree, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2015 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of Denver Sturm College of Law. She graduated in 2002. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2002.
